subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Mixed collection of runtime objects spanning the hardware-input, audio, camera-view and scene-geometry domains: a vehicle brake-bias setup control (0x00447D00), a helicopter ambient audio object (init 0x00448140 + per-frame DSP update 0x00448330), a horizontal-plane bounding-box computer (0x0044B910), a scene-track sine-table initializer (0x0044C430), the force-feedback/joystick input proxy state manager (0x0044F150) with its packed per-session flag reader/guard (0x0044F460, 0x0044F4A0), the cursor subsystem (0x0044F4E0) and frustum-viewport helper (0x0044F680), a force-feedback shader-constant provider (0x0044FCC0), the audio engine channel router (0x0044FF50), a global state configurator (0x004533A0), the input-action string registry (0x00455290), and two camera config parsers (0x004562F0, 0x004572B0).

summary: Derived architecture proposal for 16 validated functions in scope generic_runtime_objects. All owners are UNKNOWN in the packet except 0x004562F0 (CameraViewSystem, DERIVED), so every class below is a GUESS grouping. One grouping is anchored on a shared this field layout evidenced across two packet methods: HelicopterAudioObject owns the scene handle at this+0x0, the audio/DSP object at this+0x4, a float at this+0x8, a scene reference at this+0xC and a linked state at this+0x10, shared by the one-shot init 0x00448140 and the per-frame update 0x00448330. SessionFlagState groups 0x0044F460 and 0x0044F4A0 on the shared this[a2+892] packed byte array plus the shared dword_5EA43C/dword_7C569C gating. The two camera parsers (0x004562F0, 0x004572B0) are kept as separate classes because they assign different meanings to the same this offsets (rule 8). Nested-base field refs (field:*(this+0x4):..., field:*(obj+0xD88):..., etc.) and the device-table/constant/string globals are evidence-linked but their owning classes are not established, so they are carried in unresolved_evidence_refs.

Vehicle setup/UI control path (caller sub_42C440).

One-shot helicopter audio and scene init (Steward_Init path): store the top-level handle at this+0x0; when the audio device dword_8AC4C4 exists build the 'Ambient\helicopter.wav' path, create a playback object through the device vtable+92 into this+0x4 and program three DSP floats at *(this+0x4)+0x1C/0x20/0x24; walk the scene graph (LinkedListIndexedAccessor 0x0054C230), store the scene entity at this+0xC, copy a float into this+0x8 and dispatch per-child entity calls; look up the helicopter linked data by name into this+0x10 and return its scrolling offset.

Per-frame audio DSP state update (driver sub_4D4580): when the float threshold at this+0x8 is positive, accumulate a2 into this+0x14, dispatch an interrupt, and walk scene-graph children dispatching each via the scene reference at this+0xC; always fetch a scene-node position and, when the DSP object at this+0x4 is non-null, call its vtable slot +4; advance the linked state at this+0x10 via ScrollingDataOffsetAcrossLinkedEntries when a2 equals this+0x18 else LinkedListAnimationTimerDecrement, store a2 back into this+0x18 and return.

Scan triangle-strip vertex arrays from a2 to accumulate the X and Z extents; write the X center at this+0x8 and inverse half-extent scale at this+0x10 (zeroed via dwords this+0x10/this+0x14 on a degenerate range), the Z center at this+0x18 and scale at this+0x20 (dwords this+0x20/this+0x24).

Fill the global sine table flt_7CA384[0..6] with sin(index * 0.2243994752564138) (step constant from dbl_59EF50), write 1.0 into dword_7CA388[7], and return the final index 7; invoked from the scene-track-file loading path (caller 0x0044C0E0).

Per-frame force-feedback/joystick input poll: null-guard on the device object at this+0x4 and the input-enabled byte byte_5CD08D; joystick path (device type != 2) polls 20-byte events via vtable slot 0x28 into a 1280-byte buffer and merges the pressed flag by slot id; keyboard path (type == 2) reads 256 bytes via vtable slot 0x24, reacquires via slot 0x1C on device-lost errors and retries; accumulate the frame delta into axis positions at this+0x480, transition per-proxy activation states against this+0x880 thresholds, register active proxies into the word list at this+0xC88 gated by ConditionalFlagReturn(dword_5EA43C), and toggle 0x8000 sign bits for the keyboard shift-key pattern.

Packed flag bit reader (__thiscall): return bit 1 of this[a2 + 892] as 0/1, forced to 0 when ConditionalFlagReturn(dword_5EA43C) is true, dword_7C569C equals 5 and a2 != 1; queried by collision, state-trigger and unknown callers.

Session/subsession flag guard (__thiscall): return whether the per-session flag byte this[a2 + 892] is non-zero, gated by the disjunction (flag latch clear OR dword_7C569C != 5 OR a2 == 1) AND the indexed byte being set.

Cursor subsystem init (from HWInput_Enter): configure the frustum viewport to the full screen using dword_8B8DD4/dword_8B8DD8, load the four cursor image files (aCursor00Cur..aCursor03Cur) via 0x0044F540, select cursor index 0 via CursorSelectorFromArray(0), and return 0.

Configure a viewport rectangle: store top/left/right/bottom bounds into this+0x0/0x8/0xC/0x4, compute center X (this+0x10) and center Y (this+0x14), precompute reciprocal half-width (this+0x18) and reciprocal half-height (this+0x1C) for projection scaling, and return the width difference (right - left).

Per-frame force-feedback constant setup (driver sub_4537B0): when the DirectInput device at this+0x80 exists, poll via vtable slot 0x64, read 80 bytes of device state via slot 0x24, reacquire via slot 0x1C and retry on device-lost/not-acquired errors; copy the first 8 state dwords to axis floats this+0x398..0x3B4, transform each into smoothed/dead-zone-clamped output at this+0x3B8, write the constant 4-vector at this+0x3E8..0x3F4, and store 16 sign-flag bytes after the axes.

Audio engine channel-routing init: enumerate up to three device entries and match each source against the primary/secondary device tables to assign a channel category id and direction flag; create a channel per index through the device virtual setup, mirroring the primary channel into secondary/tertiary slots and clamping mute-flag globals; re-create the primary channel in race mode (dword_7D1FD8 == 3); enumerate effect devices through the audio managers at obj+0xE08 and obj+0x1204, build up to nine effect channel descriptors gated on the quality level dword_7D1FFC and per-channel float parameters, submit each via the device virtual registration method, and store per-channel rate divisors from 2*PI*1e6.

Configure global state: call ThunkToFUN004530a0 (0x00453370) with a fixed sequence of (state index, mode) pairs (states 3,2,0,1,4,5,6 mode 2; loop 26..33 mode 2 if byte_7D1370 == 1 else mode 0; then states 7,21,19,20 mode 2; 17,18 mode 1; 16,23 mode 0; 8 mode 1; 9 mode 0; 10..13 mode 1; remaining fixed pairs; finally state 43 mode 2) and return the final call result.

Straight-line free function (from HWInput_Enter) registering 44 input-action display strings (steering/throttle/brake, gears, clutch, electronic aids, pit/limiter, camera/view, session, cockpit) by passing each through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc; returns the final call result.

Parse a camera view configuration (caller 0x00408E20): when ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag reports no config section, apply defaults from the in-memory setup block; otherwise iterate config tokens parsing float pairs (offset, clip planes, LOD multiplier, size, center, mipmap LOD bias, radius limits, orientation/position offsets), integer flags and a clear-enable string, then commit values into the camera view object this+0x30..0x78 (and radius/orientation/position offsets into this+0x80..0xAC); returns 1 for an explicit section, 0 for defaults.

Parse a static camera/scene descriptor from config (called by StaticCameraSceneLoader 0x0040B030): accumulate key-value pairs (position, orientation, positional size, color, clip planes, LOD multiplier, size, center, mipmap LOD bias, flags, clear flag, activation location/radius) gated by ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag on a per-iteration flag buffer, then flush all values into the descriptor at this+0x30..0x98; returns 0 on flush and 1 when the scanner reports the stop code.

state_machines.name: StaticCameraConfigScan

token_read: sub_5651B0(v43) reads the next config token

direct_write: activation location/radius parsed directly into this+124..136

transitions: token_read (code 0) -> token_parse -> direct_write -> flag_gate re-check -> token_read

interfaces.name: IDirectInputDeviceStateReader
interfaces.purpose: Shared DirectInput device read/recovery pattern: read device state via the device object's vtable slot 0x24 (256-byte keyboard state in InputProxyStateManager, 80-byte force-feedback state in ForceFeedbackConstantProvider); on errors -2147024884 (device lost) or -2147024866 (not acquired) reacquire via vtable slot 0x1C and retry the read once. Device objects live at different this offsets (this+0x4 vs this+0x80), so this is a behavioral contract, not a shared layout.

interfaces.name: IConfigTokenConsumer
